text:
Sam H.: Hey team, PR #8567 is blocked by CI — windows-interop job timed out on egress to our internal test service. can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8567 :eyes:

deploy-bot: buildkite/job/98234 failed — windows-interop (egress-check) • exit code 137 • duration 18m

Jen L.: ugh. do we have the failing log snippet?

Sam H.: pasted the key bit below, looks like a tcp timeout from the test harness:
```
[2026-01-22 14:12:08] ERROR TestEgressIntegration - connection error: dial tcp 10.0.12.45:9042: i/o timeout
[2026-01-22 14:12:09] ERROR retrying... attempt 3/3
[2026-01-22 14:12:10] FAIL TestEgressIntegration - egress timeout after 30s
```

Kai P.: that pattern smells like the proxy in the windows workers dropping connections during bursts. last week we saw similar on job 97011. can we rerun the job to verify flakiness?

Ashley R.: +1 to rerun. if it reproduces, i'll ask infra to check the NAT gateway.

Sam H.: rerun kicked: buildkite command `bk retry build 98234` (i started it) — will post results. :crossed_fingers:

Omar C.: if it fails again can we try the same commit on a linux worker cluster to see if it's platform specific? might help narrow infra vs test bug.

deploy-bot: buildkite/job/98234 (retry #1) started by Sam H.

Jen L.: thanks. also tagging @eng-oncall in case NAT/gateway spike needs immediate attention.

Ashley R.: noted — pinging infra-sre. If it keeps failing i'll schedule a quick bisect to find the first bad commit.

Sam H.: retry finished — still failed same test with same timeout. log identical. marking as blocking merge for now.

Kai P.: okay going to re-run with debug env (increase TCP connect timeout and capture tcpdump). give me ~20m.

Omar C.: if you need me to flip routing rules to a different egress subnet for the job, i can do that after Kai's debug run.

Sam H.: appreciate it. leaving the branch unmerged until we confirm infra is stable or we have a mitigation. thanks all. :heart:
